package all_tasks_succeeded_test

import data.all_tasks_succeeded

	count(all_tasks_succeeded.deny) == 0
	with input as {
		"predicate": {
			"buildConfig": {
				"tasks": [
					{
						"name": "build",
						"status": "Succeeded",
					},

			},

	count(all_tasks_succeeded.deny) > 0

						"status": "Succeeded",
					},
					{
						"name": "test",
						"status": "Failed",
					},
				],
			},
		},
	}
